Finding submitted.

**AUDIT — deviation (fallback target), Section 6.11 (p0419).**

- **Only responsive clause binding us:** Section 6.11 (royalty/records audit of AbbVie, its Affiliates and Sublicensees). Sections 6.12–6.13 are dispute/confidentiality tails; p0332 is our inspection right over Harpoon and was not flagged.
- **Failures:** audit is exercisable "at the request of Harpoon" with no notice period at all; the frequency period and the cost-shifting variance threshold are both left open ([***]), plus an unspecified second cost trigger ("or [***]").
- **Cure (three surgical replacements in 6.11):** 15 days' prior written notice; no more than once in any twelve (12) month period; Harpoon bears cost unless the audit reveals an underpayment of more than ten percent (10%) of reported amounts.
- Preferred extras (30 days, off-site, no system access, 5% threshold) were deliberately not pursued — 10% is the better threshold for us and the auditor is already an independent nationally recognised firm with disclosure limited to discrepancies.
